graph.architecture: Role-oriented related family with Spec Impl and Game Cores, CT and Machine IRs, Shared Pure, and proof-evidence interface

edge_subject.definedness: well-formed source resolves exactly one checked pure subject
edge_subject.failure_behavior: reject without semantic identity
edge_subject.identity_inputs: source bytes; language version; elaborator identity
edge_subject.obligations: preserve pure total meaning; fail without creating identity
edge_subject.observation_requirement: checked pure subject identity or exact rejection
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: name equality does not imply semantic equality
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate elaborator is proposed trusted path

edge_subject.definedness: contracts effects memory and typed failures are explicit
edge_subject.failure_behavior: reject without effectful identity
edge_subject.identity_inputs: source bytes; language version; effect model identity
edge_subject.obligations: preserve contracts effects memory operations and typed failure
edge_subject.observation_requirement: checked effectful subject identity or exact rejection
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: shared names do not imply refinement; implementation does not define specification
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate implementation elaborator is proposed trusted path

edge_subject.definedness: low-level operations are explicit and unsupported features classified before target lowering
edge_subject.failure_behavior: reject or mark unsupported before target lowering
edge_subject.identity_inputs: source bytes; language version; low-level boundary identity
edge_subject.obligations: expose memory control flow low-level operations unsupported operations and assumptions
edge_subject.observation_requirement: checked CT-level identity or exact unsupported/rejection state
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: machine source cannot bypass checked low-level boundary
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate machine elaborator is proposed trusted path

edge_subject.definedness: sampling oracle adversary and bound structure are explicit
edge_subject.failure_behavior: reject without probabilistic identity
edge_subject.identity_inputs: source bytes; language version; probability model identity
edge_subject.obligations: preserve sampling oracle adversary and exact bound structure
edge_subject.observation_requirement: checked experiment identity or exact rejection
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: sampling does not enter pure or implementation meaning
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate game elaborator is proposed trusted path

edge_subject.definedness: judgment and all subject identities are explicit
edge_subject.failure_behavior: reject without evidence-interface identity
edge_subject.identity_inputs: proof bytes; judgment identity; subject identities
edge_subject.obligations: bind exact judgment and subjects while remaining calculus-neutral and format-neutral
edge_subject.observation_requirement: evidence-interface identity or exact rejection
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: interface admission is not proof validity and selects no calculus
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate proof elaborator only proposes an evidence binding interface

edge_subject.definedness: term belongs to versioned Shared Pure subset
edge_subject.failure_behavior: reject outside subset
edge_subject.identity_inputs: term identity; subset version; Spec domain identity
edge_subject.obligations: be total on subset and exclude effects state and sampling
edge_subject.observation_requirement: included pure subject identity or exact rejection
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: subset executability does not create universal Core
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate inclusion definition is proposed for review

edge_subject.definedness: embedding is explicit and source identity fixed
edge_subject.failure_behavior: reject when state or effects would be imported
edge_subject.identity_inputs: pure subject identity; embedding version; Impl domain identity
edge_subject.obligations: preserve deterministic pure meaning and introduce no state or ambient effects
edge_subject.observation_requirement: embedded identity and effect-free boundary observation
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: shared names do not infer refinement and embedding does not authorize state
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate embedding definition is proposed for review

edge_subject.definedness: embedding is explicit and source identity fixed
edge_subject.failure_behavior: reject when randomness would alter deterministic meaning
edge_subject.identity_inputs: pure subject identity; embedding version; Game domain identity
edge_subject.obligations: preserve deterministic meaning and introduce no ambient randomness
edge_subject.observation_requirement: embedded identity and randomness-free boundary observation
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: embedding does not establish probabilistic equivalence
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate embedding definition is proposed for review

edge_subject.definedness: both exact subjects and named relation are present
edge_subject.failure_behavior: leave exact obligation unsatisfied or reject
edge_subject.identity_inputs: Impl identity; Spec identity; relation identity; model identity
edge_subject.obligations: state explicit refinement obligation and retain assumptions and failure conditions
edge_subject.observation_requirement: exact refinement obligation identity and state
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: equal names never imply refinement and implementation never defines specification
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate relation generator is proposed and evidence remains external

edge_subject.definedness: ghost and runtime data are distinguished and lowering premises explicit
edge_subject.failure_behavior: invalidate dependent results on failed preservation
edge_subject.identity_inputs: Impl identity; lowering identity; CT model identity
edge_subject.obligations: erase ghost data without runtime effect and preserve runtime meaning
edge_subject.observation_requirement: lowered identity and preservation-obligation state
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: byte conversion is not preservation and ghost data cannot affect runtime
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate lowering and preservation argument are proposed for review

edge_subject.definedness: target and ABI parameters are explicit or unresolved
edge_subject.failure_behavior: return unsupported or reject without fallback claims
edge_subject.identity_inputs: CT identity; target-model identity; lowering identity; ABI identity
edge_subject.obligations: record unsupported operations and target assumptions without fallback claims
edge_subject.observation_requirement: target-indexed identity or exact unsupported/rejection state
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: machine observations do not become specification meaning
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate target lowering is proposed while D-011 and D-013 remain open

edge_subject.definedness: both experiment identities and exact bound expression are present
edge_subject.failure_behavior: leave exact relation unsatisfied or reject
edge_subject.identity_inputs: left identity; right identity; relation identity; bound identity
edge_subject.obligations: preserve exact bound and name reduction or equivalence explicitly
edge_subject.observation_requirement: exact probabilistic-relation identity and bound
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: reduction is not unbounded equality and prose similarity is not equivalence
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate probabilistic relation is proposed and proof policy remains open

edge_subject.definedness: checker policy remains open and all semantic identities are exact
edge_subject.failure_behavior: unknown or reject on absent or mismatched evidence or identity
edge_subject.identity_inputs: evidence identity; judgment identity; Core and IR identities; relation model version identities
edge_subject.obligations: bind evidence to every exact identity and reject substitution
edge_subject.observation_requirement: identity-bound checking state without validity claim
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: evidence presence is not validity and format conversion is not proof preservation
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate exposes checker boundary while D-006 and D-007 remain open

edge_subject.definedness: claim schema remains open and all references are exact
edge_subject.failure_behavior: retain non-success state and invalidate dependent credit
edge_subject.identity_inputs: claim identity; subject identity; relation identity; evidence identity
edge_subject.obligations: preserve failed missing unknown unsupported states and never upgrade assurance
edge_subject.observation_requirement: exact claim-binding state without capability credit
edge_subject.prohibited_reverse_inferences: claim presence does not establish truth and failed relations cannot be upgraded
edge_subject.trust_role: candidate exposes binding boundary and D-005 remains authoritative
